Intro:
Hello!

I am a Digital Engineer graduate of ISEP, and I built my career around three fields that I am passionate about: data analysis and automation, IT project management, and information systems architecture.

My experiences, particularly in banking and consulting environments, have enabled me to develop both a technical and functional approach, by understanding business needs while keeping a practical view of systems and their constraints.

I particularly enjoy analyzing a problem, understanding how the different components of an IS interact, and then building simple and effective solutions to improve processes.

Today, I want to continue evolving on projects that combine technology, data, information systems, and business challenges, ideally in an international environment.
Projet: Project Management and Software Development Lifecycle
Projet2: Agile, Translating business challenges into technical specifications, coordination, documentation
Automatisation2: GenAI, GitHub Copilot, Agents, Cloud, Linux / Windows, Docker, Kubernetes
DataVision: With specialized training in data intelligence, I design comprehensive data management and visualization solutions. From collection to analysis, through tool automation and the creation of interactive reports to support decision-making.
PMTitle: Project Management and Software Development Lifecycle
PMDesc:
Throughout my various experiences, I have contributed to several stages of the IT project lifecycle, from needs analysis through solution deployment and monitoring.
In particular, I have worked on gathering business requirements, writing specifications, designing solutions, coordinating with the various stakeholders, as well as testing, acceptance testing, and user support phases.

My experience in banking production has also enabled me to develop a strong understanding of the challenges associated with system deployment and maintenance: incident analysis, troubleshooting, root-cause identification, corrective action tracking, and coordination with technical teams.
PMSkill1Desc:
Understand user needs and business challenges in order to translate them into functional and technical requirements.
Act as a link between business and IT teams to design solutions adapted to the company's challenges.
PMSkill2Desc:
Plan development, testing, and production deployment.
Track priorities, dependencies, and approvals to ensure a controlled rollout.
PMSkill3Desc:
Monitor solutions after production deployment, analyze incidents, and contribute to their resolution.
Identify root causes and support the continuous improvement of systems.
PMProject1Desc: Implementation of the SAP Ariba solution, with involvement from pre-go-live through aftercare: configuration, documentation, support, user assistance, and continuous improvement.
PMProject2Desc: Participation in deployments and production releases, roadmap planning, and rollback management, with constant attention to the continuity of critical operations.
PMProject3Desc: Implementation of an information system to monitor the performance of a thermal power plant: understanding business challenges, writing functional specifications, and developing the solution with Microsoft Office, VB, VBA, and SQL.
PMMethodology2: Curiosity and understanding of business challenges
PMMethodology3: Writing technical specifications and requirements documents
AutoDesc:
Passionate about new technologies, I am particularly interested in generative AI and the tools that are transforming the way we design and develop solutions today.
I am convinced that mastering these tools can significantly accelerate our ability to analyze, develop, automate, and solve complex problems, while increasing our added value as digital engineers.

I also have a good understanding of information systems architectures and the interactions between their different components, from applications and databases to APIs, networks, operating systems, and Cloud infrastructures.
AutoSkill1Desc: Proficiency in generative AI, development assistance tools, and AI agents to accelerate solution design and automate complex processes and tasks.

AutoSkill3Desc: Understanding of Cloud environments and modern infrastructures, from system administration to application containerization and orchestration.
